checks.name: exact new build source
no engine starts automatically
seven histories remain fixed
cancel during decompression does not create stale frame
actual R17 native ready
native fixed source identity
one current native engine
initial swatch not generic old history
multiplier and physical units separated
generated shell target obtained from actual panel
sample pairs contain finite native distances
physical sample properties not fabricated
rendered cache and pose versions agree
old protocol and unsupported seconds preserved
observer does not call impure original reports or getError
native export is deeply frozen
synchronous read set preserved
original rendered canvas has visible content
ordinary read changes no drawing-buffer pixels
ordinary read does not advance physics
full CPU integrity read also preserves pixels
deep check preserves recorded pose and solver step
observer candidate matches original R17 whole buffer
actual thickness control rebuilds original product
main design thickness is 2.31mm at 1.65 multiplier
sampled actual shell range changes independently
full array scan is not triggered by ordinary native input
per-panel table shows generated values
original requested stitch pitch is read
actual generated seam pitch matches length divided by integer intervals
integer allocation matches original source rule
requested and generated differences are not erased
product change creates separate current object
wallet layers are read separately
no comparison between unrelated product identities
existing native physical steps are observable
export is bound to updated rendered pose
native loading and interactions added no HTTP dependencies
native export fits common import size budget
common bundle uses unchanged schema
all defects prohibit source repair
invalid import does not replace current object
file import is never current live proof
unsupported physical specimen tab cannot report old product live
supported product mode resumes real capture
retained P02 knit survives new package and controller
original knit controls still drive GPU export
old denim survives new entry
old denim native control still updates
switching retains only one engine
old leather history remains distinct and closes engine
390px core has no page overflow
file core performs no HTTP requests
no unhandled page errors
no console errors
no failed network requests
